expectation: Cytoplasmic punctate granules in cytotoxic CD8 T cells and NK cells. These should be fairly uncommon: scattered single cells, enriched in stroma and immune infiltrates at the tumour margin, with sparse cells inside tumour nests and no diffuse staining of epithelium.
observed: A: discrete bright puncta scattered across most images, dense in a few infiltrated cores; two cores show faint yellow haze. B/C: a few small bright granular cells in stroma, with near-empty background. D: clustered granular cytoplasmic dots in a few cells.
why: Sparse, discrete granular cytoplasmic signal sits in scattered stromal and immune cells with clean background, as expected for cytotoxic lymphocytes.
notes: GrzB shows as discrete granular dots in scattered single cells, denser in immune-rich cores, and the background is mostly clean. Two cores have faint diffuse haze, but the cellular population is clear.
